passes.title: EmoBeats
passes.prompt: Analyze the emotional beats in this document. Identify key emotional shifts, turning points, and the overall emotional arc. For each beat, describe the emotion, its trigger, and its narrative impact.

passes.title: Themes
passes.prompt: Extract and analyze the major themes present in this document. For each theme, provide examples from the text, explain how the theme develops, and note any thematic tensions or contradictions.

passes.title: CharacterVoice
passes.prompt: Analyze the distinct character voices in this document. For each character, describe their speech patterns, vocabulary choices, tone, and how their voice reflects their personality and role in the narrative.
